messages:
Samira (Product): Quick AH follow-up: collecting the "why" behind recent wins and losses so we can close the loop. Drop one-line notes (what tipped the deal, blockers, asks).
Jonas (Head of Sales): Win: payments infra chose Dedicated for predictable token cost + our per-route pinning. Loss: manufacturing POC went with competitor for customer-managed HSM and 10yr retention.
Pri (CS): Common asks across losses: customer KMS/HSM, retention tiers (90/365/7yr), a short audit checklist, and a procurement-ready one-pager.
Wei (SE): Win detail: per-route fallback + canary rollback saved demo during injected model drift. Customers called that "handy and trustworthy."
Wei (SE): Loss detail: manufacturing had a hard req: FIPS HSM + signed artifact per inference. They said our roadmap looked promising but timeline > procurement window.
Marcos (Infra): For tail latency complaints: reproduced a cold-start p99 spike on quantized LlamaX under autoscale. Short-term mitigation: warm-standby tasks + cache-warm hooks.
Jonas (Head of Sales): Top asks I hear: 1) Customer-managed KMS 2) Signed response capability or HMAC per inference 3) Clear retention/archival pricing 4) Dedicated vs Private controls one-pager. Those 4 unstick ~75% of enterprise deals.
Kai (Security): We can deliver a scoped attestation template as a stopgap. Long-term: support customer keys + FIPS endpoints. Need Product to define scope and expiration.
Ellen (CEO): Tactical (30-60d): attestation template, audit checklist + sample answers, Dedicated vs Private one-pager, and a short retention toggle. Strategic (quarter): customer-managed keys, signed responses, and long-term retention tiers.
Samira (Product): Action owners: Jonas -> list top 12 lost deals and exact blocker (48h). Wei -> draft warm-pool + cache warm hooks runbook (72h). Marcos -> perf test + infra cost estimate for standby warm pool (72h). Kai -> attestation template draft (48h). Pri -> audit checklist draft (48h).
Pri (CS): I'll include example answers for procurement questions and two customer quotes to make it concrete.
Jonas (Head of Sales): Can Legal sign a short-term addendum for priority accounts? That would shorten sales cycles for 3 deals I flagged.
Kai (Security): Yes, conditional on Product-scoped expiration and sign-off. Samira, include criteria in the GH issue.
SyncBot: Reminder set — "Enterprise blocker triage" scheduled Wed 09:00 PT. GH project created: https://go.redwood/gh/enterprise-wins-losses-1750123456
Samira (Product): Thanks all. I'll post the consolidated GH project and invite Product, Sales, CS, Infra, Security, and Legal. Keep replies terse so we can move fast. :rocket:
Ellen (CEO): Appreciate the quick turnaround. If a deal needs an urgent attestation, escalate to me with account name + why. :thumbsup:
